$comment: Every AsciiDoc attribute the docs UI templates, helpers, and scripts read. tests/ui-attributes checks this file against the source: a read that is not declared here fails, and so does an entry nothing reads. Keys are the names writers type in a page header (page-*) or in antora.yml (component). {n} in a key stands for each number in range.

types.html: Text rendered without escaping, so inline HTML works.
types.flag: Tested for truthiness. See caution for how empty and false values behave.
types.boolean-string: Compared with the exact string true.
types.resource-id: An Antora resource ID, root-relative path, or URL resolved by the resolve-resource helper.
types.list: Several values in one string. format gives the separator.
types.json: A JSON string. format gives the shape.
types.array: A structured array, which only an extension or YAML can provide.
types.object: A structured object, which only an extension or YAML can provide.
